words.meaning: The rising dawn of inner courage that sparks bold and visionary creative inspiration.
words.sentence1: In the quiet depth of uncertainty, she felt a sudden bravascent guiding her hand across the blank canvas. (In the quiet depth of uncertainty, she felt a sudden dawn of inner courage guiding her hand across the blank canvas.)
words.sentence2: His rousing speech awakened a spirit of bravascent across the entire auditorium. (His rousing speech awakened a spirit of courageous inspiration across the entire auditorium.)

words.meaning: A radiant flame of inner valor that illuminates creative thought and banishes apprehension.
words.sentence1: Frente a la inmensa muralla, sintio una repentina corazumbre que renovo sus energias. (Facing the immense wall, she felt a sudden radiant valor that renewed her energies.)
words.sentence2: Esa melodia apasionada desperto una profunda corazumbre en los artistas del pueblo. (That passionate melody awakened a deep courageous inspiration in the town's artists.)

words.meaning: A sudden, electrifying surge of daring that stirs the heart to inventive and intrepid action.
words.sentence1: Face au grand vide, elle ressentit un elancour supreme qui dissipa toute hesitation. (Faced with the great void, she felt a supreme surge of daring that dispelled all hesitation.)
words.sentence2: Cet elancour lumineux a conduit les pionniers vers de nouveaux sommets de creation. (This luminous surge of courageous inspiration led the pioneers to new heights of creation.)

words.meaning: The spirited inner impulse to reach beyond boundaries through courageous conviction.
words.sentence1: Mit unerschuetterlicher Kuehnstrebung betrat die junge Forscherin das unentdeckte Land. (With unwavering courageous drive, the young researcher stepped into the undiscovered land.)
words.sentence2: Ihre eindringlichen Worte entfachten eine Welle der Kuehnstrebung unter den Zuhoerern. (Her poignant words ignited a wave of courageous inspiration among the listeners.)

words.meaning: A sudden flash of brave insight that dissolves fear and inspires artistic or noble resolve.
words.sentence1: Fukai zetsubou no naka de, kanojo wa yuubirameki o kanjite shizuka ni tachiagatta. (In the depths of despair, she felt a brave flash of insight and quietly stood up.)
words.sentence2: Sono takumi no kotoba ga, wakamono-tachi no mune ni tsuyoi yuubirameki o tomoshita. (The artisan's words lit a powerful spark of courageous inspiration in the hearts of the youth.)

words.meaning: An ardent and luminous bravery that kindles the imagination toward heroic endeavors.
words.sentence1: Nel mezzo della tempesta, il suo ardispirito illumino il cammino di tutti i compagni. (In the midst of the storm, his ardent bravery illuminated the path for all companions.)
words.sentence2: Ogni pennellata sulla grande tela era intrisa di un vibrante ardispirito. (Every stroke on the large canvas was infused with a vibrant courageous inspiration.)

words.meaning: The luminous awakening of the mind where resolute courage and creative inspiration merge.
words.sentence1: Zai weinan zhi ji, ta xinzhong shengqi le yonglizhao, zhaoliang le qianfang de lianchuang. (In the moment of peril, a courageous inspiring radiance arose in her heart, illuminating the path ahead.)
words.sentence2: Zhe shou haofang de shi chongman le yonglizhao, jiwei le zhiqu yuan-da de renmen. (This magnificent poem is brimming with inspiring courage, motivating people with grand ambitions.)

words.meaning: A deep, liberating breath of bravery that uplifts the spirit and sparks imaginative daring.
words.sentence1: Duryeoum ape seon geunyeoneun kkeutnae yonggitsum-eul naeswimyeo mude-ro na-agatta. (Standing before fear, she at last exhaled a breath of brave inspiration and stepped onto the stage.)
words.sentence2: Geu geurim-eun man-eun saramdeul-ui gaseum-e ttatteuthan yonggitsum-eul buleonoeotta. (That painting breathed a warm, inspiring courage into the hearts of many people.)

words.meaning: A noble resilience of spirit that evokes transformative thoughts and imaginative strength.
words.sentence1: Now pel chuob kar-lom-bak, neang mean thleungbandal knong chet daem-bey bangkurt sna-day thmey. (In times of difficulty, she possessed an inspiring courage in her heart to create a new masterpiece.)
words.sentence2: Vak-chak thleungbandal robos lok kruu ban chuoy sors thveur kar teang klang-kla. (The teacher's inspiring courage helped students undertake their work with great strength.)

words.meaning: A vital spark of valor that kindles renewed visionary passion within the human heart.
words.sentence1: Tydens die donkerste oomblik het 'n moedvonk in haar binneste ontvlam om die uitdaging aan te gryp. (During the darkest moment, a spark of brave inspiration ignited within her to seize the challenge.)
words.sentence2: Sy woorde het 'n onstuitbare moedvonk onder die jong kunstenaars laat opstaan. (His words raised an unstoppable spark of courageous inspiration among the young artists.)
